items.english: It was in a dim, faint light, and, quiet like that light, three people drawing together with their heads together telling a long story. That story seemed to go on between them, so long and without ceasing. And in that story all seemed to be told, all the good and evil of the world, sorrow and suffering and anger and anguish, and joy, all of it. Yet those who spoke and those who listened only went on quietly and peacefully smiling, and they did not move at all. With their heads inclined and their eyes lowered, only quiet fond remembrance and forgiveness seemed to wrap them. And there too a deep, deep peace showed itself in all of them.
notes: Kept the three people unidentified and the picture a picture: no heaven, death or judgement added. Chose plain 'fond remembrance' for natsukashimi and 'forgiveness' for yurushi, and kept smile, all, long and quiet repeated as in the Japanese.

items.english: All things of the world, a life, would pass. And only on that day, when it had passed, would all, all things, turn to fond remembrance and forgiveness. And at that time they would be before a rest like night, forever.
notes: Left 'that day' and 'a rest like night, forever' literal and unresolved; no consolation or doctrine concluded. Kept 'all, all things' and the same 'fond remembrance and forgiveness' as p16.

items.english: The far picture was mirrored darkly and quietly in the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far off in the future, with a lonely peace, that picture was to be seen. Young as she was, she sighed a lonely, secret sigh by herself, and glanced at the littered table and at the faces of her husband and the child, and remained silent.
notes: Kept 'far', 'eyes', 'lonely' and 'quiet' repeated as distance-words, and 'remained silent' to hold the silence against the earlier noise.
